prompt: A shower of sparks for a pixel art sports game, plays once, about 1.2 seconds. Short bright spark streaks shoot upward and outward from the bottom centre in a fan, arc over and fall, fading as they drop. Colours: only white to light grey, so the game can tint them. Transparent background, crisp pixels, about 96 pixels across, no glow halo, no text.
message: A one-shot spark shower of about 1.3 seconds on a 96 by 112 transparent canvas: short white-to-grey streaks burst up and out from the bottom centre in a fan, arc over and fall, fading as they drop, with a few small dots among them. There is no glow or halo and no text. Sliders to try: the spark speed and gravity for height and fall, and the spread for fan width.
